policy: Consumer-controlled identifiers (custom-property names, animation names, font family names, layer names and other non-CSS words) may appear in a published declaration set only when listed here with a reason. Extraction replaces every other one with a digest placeholder; the corpus validator rejects any that remains. CSS language vocabulary is listed in tools/coverage/publication.mjs.
